links.comparator_used: black-box AI model (staging recommendation without explanation)
links.outcome: Radiologists' willingness to adopt the AI-CDSS (Likert-rated adoption likelihood) in PET/CT lung cancer TNM staging
links.effect: All explanation approaches, including input feature attribution, significantly increased willingness to adopt versus black-box (p < 0.05). Explanations were rated useful for confirming or challenging AI staging recommendations (p < 0.001). Effect sizes were not given in the abstract and results were not reported separately for feature attribution.
links.tradeoff: A trade-off between explanation depth and usability was identified as a key factor influencing preferences.
links.quote: All explanation approaches significantly increased radiologists' willingness to adopt the AI system compared to a black-box model (p < 0.05).

design_hint: explainable AI explanations (feature attribution, concept, global transparency) for clinician oversight
